name: nouns end-to-end walkthrough

checkpoints.name: in a short window the refresh modal keeps the focused pick drawn and highlighted as j and k move, with its own - and + lines above it

standard delete over a visual selection: V d asks the row's own prompt with its label read from the store, V j d counts the rows; neither fills {{label}} from collection.apply's own arguments ("Delete demo true?" in v0.56.0)
standard get refuses a human key two things hold and names both ids; nothing is read as a prefix
standard set over a visual selection: V j then D (demo.set status done) writes each selected row's task once, in order, one notice counts the rows; the row left out is not written
a hand-built show form uses the app related stack once, keeps hidden and empty settings, follows selection, writes fields and shows history last; a borrowed custom view survives stack off/on
form under text: a hand-built page that opts in (detail showForm) keeps its own detail text on top and draws the selected thing's show form and its sections under it, following the selection
z a on an index shows its archived rows, and again hides them; hidden, the filter line counts them

a 20,000-thing paged store: its index reads one page of 200 and the archived count (no full list: the writes hold no list; the show form gets the selected thing once), says the page and the total, and collection.page-next reads the next page
an empty generated index keeps its row noun's keys without a fake row: help lists n, show asks for a real id, and n opens the creation form and persists the first thing

enter on a Nouns row opens the noun's index page (nouns/chore): its things in the derived columns (the label, then short choosable props, then updated), one page read from the store, the archived ones hidden and counted on the filter line; the index page is not a tab, and leaving it leaves the tab row as it was
an index sorts and filters through the list's own keys: the sort goes into the store's query and the page is read again
a noun's index page is not a tab: while it is open the tab row keeps the tab it was opened from current (the Nouns page), never the first tab

the Nouns page is the last tab: every noun grouped by kind with its count, archived count and store; a paged store is counted with one-row pages (no full list), command nouns list their actions, drawn parts are left out; r reads the counts again and an unchanged change token reads nothing; ctrl+j wraps back to the first tab
an index page's detail is the edit form over the selected thing: } moves into it, i edits a field, the change is written as typed (no save key), and the form follows the selection
the show form of an index row: every prop as a form, one section per referring noun (memos about it, steps of it) under it, and its history last, which a write to the thing grows
Related sections: d u unassociates a row, u undoes it
Related sections: j spills across sections, z a folds, ] ] walks headings
esc on a story chooser a row verb opened over a visual selection resumes the selection (R5.16, every chooser, not only edit's); a pick ends it
create {from: row} copies the focused thing: every prop create writes, under a new key
edit chooser over marked rows: picking the focused row's own value still writes the other marked rows
the edit chooser opens with the current value highlighted (form choice parity)
esc on the edit chooser opened over a visual selection resumes the selection (R5.16); a pick then still ends it
edit chooser over a visual selection: picking the value the cursor row already holds still writes the other selected rows
m over a visual selection: the edit chooser's title counts the rows a pick writes (Edit 2 demos project), as Move 3 rows to does
m over a visual selection opens the owner chooser once and writes the pick to every selected row, one undo step
a user bindings.json row naming a removed verb says what to write instead
r over a visual selection edits the human key of the focused row only and says it left the rest as they were
set of a role the noun lacks says which role is missing
